source_semantic_observation: The reference uses a full descending sort to identify the simplex threshold. The KKT system instead permits finite active-set elimination: for an active set S, theta=(sum(y_S)-1)/|S|; elements at or below theta can be removed, and repeating until stable yields the exact simplex support. Risk-staged variants certify KKT conditions and fall back to the source-faithful sort if necessary.
implementation_rules: v4_full maps active_set_decomposition + vectorized_batch_kernel + risk_aware_staging to finite vectorized support elimination with a 64-stage cap, KKT certificate and exact sort fallback
v4_no_transfer follows its separately frozen proposal order and is allowed the same source-derived active-set primitive when its proposal contains active_set_decomposition
random_search and template_synthesis retain strong active-set controls whenever their frozen proposal explicitly contains active_set_decomposition; they are not weakened to protect v4
dtype candidates use lower precision only to hypothesize support, then recompute theta in float64 and require a KKT certificate before acceptance
v3_compatible stays within sort/representation/dtype/contiguity mechanisms and does not use active-set decomposition
correctness_boundary: Synthetic candidates must match an independent exhaustive KKT support-enumeration oracle to 2e-10 absolute/relative tolerance, remain nonnegative and sum to one within 2e-10.
